newsitem.title: USA: Norwest to buy back up to 4.5 mln shares.
newsitem.headline: Norwest to buy back up to 4.5 mln shares.

text.p: Norwest Corp said Tuesday its board had voted to authorize the repurchase, from time to time, of up to 4.5 million shares.
The company has about 371 million shares outstanding.

"The shares, to be purchased at market price, will be used to meet periodic stock requirements of Norwest's benefit plans, for our stockholder dividend reinvestment plan, for the conversion of convertible securities, for acquisitions and for other corporate purposes," John Thornton, chief financial officer, said in a statement.
He said the buyback program will continue to be managed in a manner that will not prevent Norwest from using pooling-of-interests accounting for acquisitions.
Norwest provides banking, insurance investments and other financial services.
